ValidationRule.description: D34: Type = 'Daily Donation Pledge' marks a pledge. It can't be changed on a pledge, and a regular Opportunity can't become one by hand (only the integration creates pledges).
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISNEW()), ISCHANGED(Type), OR(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Type), 'Daily Donation Pledge'), ISPICKVAL(Type, 'Daily Donation Pledge')) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: לא ניתן לשנות את סוג ההזדמנות של הוראת תרומה יומית.
